bosses.name: Vardorvis

attacks.name: head
attacks.evidence: measured, n=4: gaze landed, small, no heal

attacks.name: melee
attacks.evidence: certain: melee anim a tick before

bosses.notes: Strength and defence move linearly from full hitpoints to none (DPS calc scaling/Vardorvis.ts). The stats file stores both as 0. Defence cannot be drained (DPS calc DefenceReduction.ts floor = current defence). attacksOnPlayer (T-041): from T-039's 23 kills of Eric's 2026-10-27 logs and the OSRS Wiki's Vardorvis and Vardorvis/Strategies pages (read 2026-10-27); every id in it was seen in those logs. Melee and spikes heal him half the hit, axes and his head's gaze do not; an axe's bleed (splat 67) follows it within 6 ticks; Protect from Melee lets a quarter of his melee through, at most 10. A failed strangle has never been logged, so it is not named: it counts as chip until a log shows it.

bosses.name: Araxxor
bosses.unmodelled: Enraged phase adds 35 defence, 28 magic and 31 ranged levels (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). The enrage is not tracked, so expected figures after it read high.

bosses.name: Yama
bosses.unmodelled: Magic defence bonus is +60 while the tank uses magic and -30 otherwise, outside phase 3 (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). The tank's style is not tracked.

bosses.name: Abyssal Sire
bosses.notes: Ids per version from the wiki's Abyssal Sire page (id1 = 5886,5887,5888; id2 = 5889,5890; id3 = 5891; id4 = 5908); the DPS calc's data lists only 5886, 5889, 5891 and 5908. Stage 2 has half the defence bonuses. Phase 1: any damage only counts towards disorienting it, and it is restored to full health by the end of the phase (wiki, Abyssal Sire/Strategies); in Eric's 10 kills of 2026-10-27 everything after phase 1 came to 425-452 whatever phase 1 took (0-100). The 0-27 over 425 is not explained (not the 50% transition reduction, not damage taken); the margin covers it so the last attacks are not capped short. Not modelled: if it reaches 0 before phase 2 it starts at 40%, before phase 3 at 20% (wiki). XP: all 42 clean melee drops on stage 2 decode at x1.125 to the splats they paid for, as on the other phases; 25 of them do not at the x1.100 the formula gives on stage 2's stats.

bosses.name: Bork
bosses.unmodelled: Each phase adds magic resistance and flat armour (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). Phases are not tracked.
